scope: Wii runtime loaders for HWT1/HRA1/HWS1 proven in stock Dolphin; conversion of models, BSP lightmap geometry, collision, model animations, fonts and unicode text; shader in-place decision; full conversion on Research and Titan
privacy: Counts, formats, sizes and hashes only. No owned bytes, names, map names or host paths. Maps are referred to by category and ordinal only.

source.converter_commit_note: merge of the category commit 483154b1 with wii 60825927; port/wii/content, content_loader_cases.py, run_dolphin.py and the input script are unchanged between 1419143f and 1f9c598c

loaders.compile_flags: C11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror (Wii CFLAGS); host build with the same warnings

texture_over_gx_limit.checked: CPU decode digest only, not uploaded

recorded_animations.note: every owned recorded animation is version 4; the v1 codec is covered by the host fixtures

dolphin.launch: Dolphin.exe --user <new isolated profile> --batch --video_backend D3D --exec content_loaders.dol --movie input.dtm
dolphin.host_lock: dolphin_lock.py acquired before and released after the batch

timing_emulated_us_cycle_1_run_1.scope: Dolphin emulated time base, not hardware timing

dolphin.persistence: run counter advanced 1 then 2 across cold launches; prior guest log preserved; every staged file read back identical after each launch
dolphin.os_stability: no_instability_events_observed (Windows System and Application logs over the batch window)

loaders.host_tests: tools/wii/test_content_loaders.py builds the loaders with the host compiler and runs the same cases on authored fixtures

decisions.models: converted: HWM1 (parts, Xbox compressed vertices, u16 indices)
decisions.lightmaps: converted: HWL1 per scenario structure BSP (lightmaps, materials, environment and lightmap vertices, surfaces); lightmap bitmaps already convert as HWT1 textures
decisions.collision: converted: HWC1 per collision model and per structure BSP
decisions.model_animations: converted: HMA1 (frame info, defaults, frames, compressed arrays)
decisions.fonts: converted: HWF1 (metrics, character tables, characters, verbatim 8-bit glyph pixels)
decisions.strings: converted: HUS1 (unicode string lists and HUD message text, UTF-16 big-endian)
decisions.shaders: read in place after ADR-015 relocation: typed tag fields only, no tag-data or file payload in any shader group schema; census only
decisions.string_lists_8bit: read in place: 8-bit text has no byte order

owned_layout_facts.model_parts: all 10,862 use the compressed model vertex (type 5) and precompiled strips; every buffer resolves to the map's descriptor tables and every index is below its part's vertex count
owned_layout_facts.bsp_materials: all 14,642 use compressed environment (1) and lightmap (3) vertices; data size equals 32 x vertices + 8 x lightmap vertices; no uncompressed vertex data
owned_layout_facts.compressed_animations: all 186 compressed blocks are covered exactly by their typed arrays with no gaps or overlaps
owned_layout_facts.blank_glyphs: some glyphs carry a negative bitmap width with height 0 (no pixels)
owned_layout_facts.empty_collision_leaves: empty leaves name first reference -1 with count 0

categories.fixture_tests: tools/wii/test_content_categories.py (11 tests): conversion and explicit decode of every category, determinism, nine authored defects, interruption and disk-full, container validation, tag offsets against cache_schema_tables.c

full_conversion.categories: all ten (textures, animations, sounds, models, lightmaps, collision, model_animations, fonts, strings, shaders)
